title: Law to let groups request shared street trash bins
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to create a process for block associations or non-profit groups to request a shared stationary on-street waste container for two or more residential buildings. Sanitation would contact building owners to confirm participation, decide if a shared container is workable and, if so, install it and notify owners of their responsibilities and any fees. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
